Derrick, saw Bolt lined up partnerships with Socure, Affirm, and Toffee to deepen checkout and the Bolt ID layer.

New partner-driven motions usually mean more merchants worth a conversation than the team can cover before interest fades. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Bolt off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Derrick, quick follow-up for Bolt.

Every new integration usually pulls the number up faster than the headcount you can add to chase it, and lean teams feel that gap first. Most teams cannot say exactly how many meetings each rep needs.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Bolt needs to close that gap this quarter, plus where the math breaks if you only add reps.

Derrick, last bit of proof for Bolt.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Bolt's reply rate likely compares to other commerce and payments teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
